hero.subtitle: At DualGrid, we combine design with development to create visual identities, websites and digital systems with care, craft and real attention to detail.

why.title: Design and development, thought together
why.subtitle: We work with seriousness, visual sensitivity and technical judgment so every brand and website communicates better, inspires trust and feels well resolved from start to finish.

items.title: 100% custom design
items.desc: No generic templates. Every website and visual identity is designed from scratch around what your business needs to communicate and sell.

items.title: Full service
items.desc: We handle design, development, branding, domain setup and hosting so you do not have to coordinate multiple providers.

items.title: Direct communication
items.desc: You work directly with us from start to finish. Clear communication, quick replies and no unnecessary middlemen.

items.title: Web & branding in one place
items.desc: We design your brand and your website under the same visual direction, so everything feels coherent, professional and well resolved.

items.title: Perfect on all devices
items.desc: Your website is designed to look good and work smoothly on mobile, tablet and desktop from the very beginning.

items.title: Clean and secure code
items.desc: We build with performance, structure and security in mind so your project stays reliable now and easier to maintain later.

process.title: A clear process for every project
process.subtitle: We follow a clear process from the start so you know what will be done, how long it may take and what kind of result to expect.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.desc: Initial meeting to understand your goals, style and target audience.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.desc: We send a detailed proposal with scope, price and timeline.

steps.desc: We build the website or refine the final identity files. Technical rigor and attention to detail in every step.

steps.title: Support

essential_features: 1 conceptual proposal + 1 round of minor adjustments (color or typography).
Corporate color palette with all necessary technical codes.
Primary and secondary typeface selection for communication consistency.
Basic Usage Guide (PDF) with essential guidelines to apply your logo correctly, allowed backgrounds, and usage errors to avoid.
corporate_features: 2 conceptual proposals + 2 complete revision rounds on the selected option.
Main version + adaptive variants (horizontal, vertical, and isotype for avatars).
Detailed color palette and corporate font system.
Custom support graphic elements such as patterns, textures, or custom iconography to enrich your brand.
Complete Visual Identity Manual defining the art direction, visual communication tone, logo construction grids and technical restriction areas.
Design of 3 to 4 applications chosen according to business needs.
global_features: 3 conceptual proposals + 3 exhaustive rounds of detailed revisions.
Main version + adaptive variants (horizontal, vertical, and isotype for avatars).
Detailed color palette and corporate font system.
Custom support graphic elements such as patterns, textures, or custom iconography.
Complete Visual Identity Manual with art direction, visual communication tone, logo construction grids and restriction areas.
Structured sub-brand system design to define with visual coherence how different business units or lines relate to each other.
Suite of up to 10 advanced corporate applications to choose from.
branding_plans.essential_target: Ideal for: early-stage brands that need a clear, usable and professional identity from the beginning.
branding_plans.corporate_target: Ideal for: growing brands that want to stand out better and bring more order to their visual communication.
branding_plans.global_target: Ideal for: established businesses or umbrella brands that need structure, consistency and visual control.
